label: Bible Study
prompt: Be _____, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
note: 'Be still' here means 'cease striving' — a command, and a kindness.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said, My _____ shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verse: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
note: Moses wouldn't move without it — the presence was the point, not the promised land.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy _____ from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verse: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
note: Moses at the burning bush: the KJV says 'shoes,' though most flannelgraphs drew sandals.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Though he _____ me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verse: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
note: Job's defiant trust: even the worst case doesn't cancel the contract.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was _____ in the house of my friends.
verse: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
note: A haunting line preachers have long heard echoing toward Calvary: wounded in the house of friends.
